Fun app to use, I think it’s helping keep up language skills. Math and chess are neat as well. Cons: they’ve added so many ads that the experience is frustratingly slow sometimes. Also the frequent icon changes are not great - I get that it’s trying to encourage you to do the lesson, but I’m going to do one anyway. Everyone or at least people with streaks should be able to opt out of that annoying feature.
